title: Locking before hurricane or strong wind conditions.
officialText:
If a hurricane or strong wind conditions are expected, the commissioner may order that small wind turbines equipped with passive locks be stopped and locked.
*Section 3113.5.1 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
